title: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A cathar from Gavony who rose to become Lothar's second in command and then the Guardian of Thraben, sworn to protect the Helvault.

entities.name: Lothar
entities.description: The revered Guardian of Thraben who led the Lunarch's elite protectors; he died during the ghoul siege.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: The Lunarch of the Avacynian Church who kept the secret of Avacyn's imprisonment and was killed in the assault on Thraben.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel protector of Innistrad, imprisoned in the Helvault after her duel with Griselbrand.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: An elder demon who dueled Avacyn and was trapped with her in the Helvault.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A moon-silver obelisk in Thraben Cathedral's courtyard that imprisons demons, Avacyn and Griselbrand.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A zombie master who, with his sister Gisa, besieged Thraben with ghouls and skaabs.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A zombie master who, with her brother Geralf, besieged Thraben with ghouls and skaabs.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who sold her soul to four demons and hunts them across planes; she has come to Innistrad seeking Griselbrand.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: The first of the four demons who claim Liliana's soul; she has killed him.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker beast-hunter cursed by Liliana with the Chain Veil, who pursues her relentlessly.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: A dark artifact Liliana wields that tempts her with ever-greater power.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who took part in creating Avacyn.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A cult of demon worshippers in Thraben.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church that reveres Avacyn and has kept her fate secret.

entities.name: Krallenhorde werewolves
entities.description: A howlpack of werewolves Thalia charged to save an old man.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The holy city housing Thraben Cathedral and the Helvault.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane in which humanity is dying out as monsters prey upon it.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: An Innistrad province where Liliana searched near the Ashmouth.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: An Innistrad province with the towns Havengul and Selhoff.

events.summary: Thalia charges into a howlpack of Krallenhorde werewolves to rescue a single old man, impressing Lothar, who makes her one of his elite guardians.
events.quote: Lothar made her part of his elite guardians that very day.

events.summary: Flashback: Avacyn and Griselbrand duel on the Helvault; Griselbrand stabs her, her binding spell backlashes, and both fall into the Helvault.
events.quote: Both the devious demon lord and the wounded angel fell into the Helvault , plunging Innistrad into a time of darkness.

events.summary: Mikaeus decides to keep the Helvault's nature secret, telling Lothar only to protect it.
events.quote: The decision was made, and the nature of the giant silver shard was kept quiet.

events.summary: Thalia takes the oath to never allow the Helvault to come to harm.
events.quote: Thalia took the same oath that Lothar swore

events.summary: Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben with ghouls and skaabs.
events.quote: They besieged the city of Thraben with their ghoulish army

events.summary: Thalia traps the undead hordes with straw and burns them in a great circle of fire.
events.quote: She outwitted the ghouls and skaabs, burning them to ash in a great circle of fire

events.summary: Lothar, tormented by evil voices, plunges to his death from a Thraben wall.
events.quote: Lothar plunged off one of Thraben's high walls to his death.

events.summary: Mikaeus is killed in the assault and entombed in secret beneath the cathedral.
events.quote: So Mikaeus was entombed in secret, whisked away to the clandestine catacombs beneath the cathedral.

events.summary: Thalia becomes the Guardian of Thraben, unknowingly keeping Avacyn sealed.
events.quote: Thalia took charge of the elite guardians of Thraben, becoming the Guardian of Thraben in her predecessor's stead.

events.summary: Liliana searches Innistrad for Griselbrand, snuffing out devils in Stensia and following gossip in Nephalia to the Skirsdag cult in Thraben.
events.quote: Her inquiries got her to a name and a place: the Skirsdag cult and the city of Thraben.

events.summary: Garruk, afflicted by Liliana's curse, pursues her across Innistrad.
events.quote: Even as she is on Griselbrand's trail, Garruk is on hers

events.summary: Liliana doubts the Chain Veil even as she needs it against Garruk.
events.quote: she is beginning to feel doubts about the wisdom of using the Chain Veil to further her death magic

relations.quote: Soon, she rose to become Lothar's second in command

relations.note: Led elite protectors in service of the Lunarch.
relations.quote: a revered soldier who led a force of elite protectors in service of the Lunarch
Griselbrand tricked Avacyn, though, stabbing her through the heart with his spear

relations.note: Stands in the Thraben Cathedral courtyard.
relations.quote: the great silver obelisk in the Cathedral courtyard
Geralf and Gisa, that sibling team of zombie masters

relations.note: She cursed him with the Chain Veil; he hunts her.
relations.quote: the planeswalker Garruk Wildspeaker , whom she cursed at their last meeting with the dreaded Chain Veil
She has already killed Kothophed, the first of the four demons who claim her soul.

relations.note: Sorin had a role in her creation.
relations.quote: You've learned the role of the vampire planeswalker Sorin in the creation of Avacyn
